audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer put Volibear's stun on E and called it 'Frenzied Maul into Sky Splitter'. It also said his R shields him, and named his passive 'Gathering Storm'.
audit.why: Riot's data: Q Thundering Smash is the stun and the gap-close (300 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, and an auto-attack reset). E Sky Splitter is a 1200-range lightning drop that slows and shields HIM if he stands in it — no stun. R Stormbringer leaps, slows, disables towers and grants bonus HEALTH, not a shield. The passive is The Relentless Storm.
audit.corrected: Stun moved to Thundering Smash with its real cooldown, Sky Splitter described as slow-plus-self-shield, Stormbringer's bonus health corrected, passive renamed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart said Ryze wins Level 1 while whys[0] said Volibear does; Level 3 and First item were 'Skill' while their whys described clear Ryze windows.
audit.why: Level 1 is a melee bruiser with a free heal versus a Ryze with only Q — he wins it. Level 3 (full Flux loop) and Seraph's are Ryze's stated windows, and the packet chart agrees.
audit.corrected: Volibear, Skill, Ryze, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze — paired full/content rows with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike credited Stormbringer with a shield.
audit.why: It grants bonus Health and disables nearby towers on a 160/135/110s cooldown; the shield in his kit belongs to Sky Splitter.
audit.corrected: Spike rewritten to bonus health plus tower disable, with the pre-root answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appeared only in the itemization line; nothing said his damage scales with attack speed.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul heals on the second cast against the same target on a 5s cooldown, and applies on-hit effects while The Relentless Storm stacks attack speed — armour alone misreads the trade.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into the Don'ts; the on-hit/attack-speed point written into the levels 4-5 why.

edits.after: Thundering Smash is the stun and an auto-reset — his wind-up is your tell, not any cast bar.

edits.before: The run-down stun — make distance the moment he starts glowing. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is an auto-reset stun — the wind-up is the tell. Step off it, then commit into the gap.

edits.before: Volibear spends Thundering Smash (Stun) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Volibear spends Thundering Smash early — you own the next 12 seconds at rank 1, so use them.

edits.before: That’s Volibear’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul heals on its second cast — buy Grievous Wounds before you extend.

edits.before: Your W root comes online and gives you a first real threat vs his melee kit, but his E stun can interrupt your combo if you root him without checking whether E is off cooldown — it's genuinely even until one player misses a key skill.
edits.after: Your W root comes online and gives you a first real threat vs his melee kit, but Thundering Smash stuns straight through your step-up whenever it is off cooldown — genuinely even until one player misses a key skill.

edits.before: Pre-item mana costs make extended cycling expensive and Volibear's W heal keeps him durable through short trades — neither side forces a decisive outcome, so farm priority matters more than kill hunting.
edits.after: Pre-item mana costs make cycling expensive, and Frenzied Maul both heals him and applies on-hit while The Relentless Storm stacks attack speed — armour alone misreads this trade, so farm priority beats kill hunting.

edits.before: Volibear's R disables the tower and shields him for a free dive window, matching or outweighing Realm Warp's macro value in the 1v1 context — pre-root him the moment his R lands to burn E before he can stun you.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables the tower and grants him bonus health for a free dive, matching Realm Warp's macro value in the 1v1 context — root him the moment the leap lands, before Thundering Smash starts the fight.

edits.before: Volibear's E stun (Frenzied Maul into Sky Splitter) can interrupt your combo mid-cast — respect it and hold W until after he burns E.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is both his stun and his gap-closer, up every 12s at rank 1 — hold W until he spends it, then root him for the downtime.

edits.before: Volibear's R disables your tower and gives him a free dive window with his shield active — stand behind your tower ring or pre-root him under it the instant his R lands.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables your tower and grants him bonus health for a free dive window — stand off the tower ring, or W-root him the instant the leap touches down.

edits.before: Use E stun to interrupt Ryze mid-combo or lock him in place for a free all-in

edits.before: From levels 4-5 the lane becomes a sustained attrition grind — Volibear heals a meaningful chunk of every trade with his W, so never let him proc it unopposed; always open with the W-root so he is anchored and spending his W on a stationary target while your Flux bounces do work. His Gathering Storm passive means he genuinely threatens you if he lands multiple bites, so keep the minion wave between you when resetting. At level 6 his R is a legitimate threat: it disables your tower, gives him a personal shield, and turns his already-bruiser body into a dive engine — the moment you see the lightning drop, pre-root him with W so his Q dash lands him into an active root and burns his E cooldown before he can use it on you rather than the tower. Use Realm Warp proactively here not as a combat tool but to sidestep the dive angle entirely if his jungler is nearby.
edits.after: From levels 4-5 the lane becomes a sustained attrition grind — Frenzied Maul heals him on every second cast against the same target on a 5-second cooldown, so never let him land the pair unopposed; open with the W-root so he is anchored while your Flux bounces do work. The Relentless Storm stacks attack speed as he keeps hitting, so each extra second in his range costs more than the last — keep the minion wave between you when resetting. At level 6 Stormbringer is a legitimate threat: it disables your tower, grants him bonus health, and turns a bruiser into a dive engine — the moment the leap lands, W-root him so Thundering Smash cannot start the fight and his stun burns on nothing. Use Realm Warp here not as a combat tool but to sidestep the dive angle entirely if his jungler is nearby.

notes: Sky Splitter's shield applies to Volibear only when he stands inside his own blast radius — that is a real 'bait him off the circle' cue, but no in-band field was left to carry it after the higher-priority stun correction; worth a future pass. The full layer's focus/loading strings already used the correct 'Thundering Smash (Stun)' label, so only the content layer carried the wrong-slot error.
